summary: Well-executed, preregistered paired study that cleanly isolates a repair-only estimand under shared_initial_candidate semantics. Execution and archival artifacts appear complete; the manuscript accurately documents the design, preregistration, execution accounting, deterministic verifier oracle, and the limited inferential strength given the very high baseline pass rate. No substantive scientific errors were found, but the manuscript needs a small set of clarifying revisions before finalisation (primarily formatting and minor bookkeeping clarifications that are resolvable from the archived artifacts).
required_revisions: Include a conventional IEEE numbered References section in the manuscript using the verified bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL) already present in the archived terminal_bibliographic_records; ensure every in-text numeric citation maps to an IEEE bibliography entry. This is mandatory per the venue and verification rules and can be satisfied from the supplied metadata artifacts.

Clarify the provider-call accounting language in Methods/Execution (and, if present, in the Disclosure Statement) to resolve an apparent potential confusion in the reconciliation artifact: explain the meaning of provider_call_audit.condition_counts (why it reports {"shared":200,"guarded":1}) and explicitly state that stage_counts = {shared_initial_generation:200, repair:1} is the authoritative provider-call accounting for model-call counts. Cite the deterministic_reconciliation.json artifact when making this clarification.

Ensure the Disclosure Statement explicitly names the code/experiment orchestration and analysis components (adapter: hosted_netops_gvr_v1; deterministic task generator: deterministic_netops_task_generator_v5; verifier: deterministic_netops_validator_v5; analysis executor: paired_binary_analysis_v1) in a concise list, and confirm the single required immutable master-prompt locator and SHA-256 remain present exactly as archived. This must be in the five-page manuscript Disclosure text and may be drawn from the archived manifest.
optional_revisions: Add a brief note in Methods (one sentence) explaining the exact McNemar two-sided p-value convention used when n = n10 + n01 is small (e.g., n=1) and direct readers to the analysis_log.jsonl for the exact implementation; this helps readers interpret p = 1.0 in the observed sparse-discordant regime.

Consider adding one short row or boxed pointer in Methods or Disclosure that maps a few key archived artifact filenames (execution/raw_results.jsonl, execution/model_configuration.json, analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv, deterministic_reconciliation.json) to the principal numbers in the Results for rapid auditability.

Optionally, expand the Discussion by one concise paragraph (≤4–5 sentences) noting practical implications for studies that instead permit independent guarded first-pass generations (i.e., clarifying how this repair-only estimand differs from independent-sampling guarded contrasts).
